records.context: Count every transcript or bin into the cells of the spatial fields.
records.label: spacr.ops_engine.run_spatial_map#0

records.translation: Compte chaque transcrit ou bin dans les cellules des champs spatiaux.

records.context: Reads the whole Xenium bundle (transcripts at ``spatial_min_qv``) or one Visium HD bin size, puts every point in full-resolution pixels of the slide image (:func:`_st_slide_xy`), then in the frame of each field Spatial Mask Generation wrote (:func:`_st_field_frame`), and counts it into the object of each image layer named in ``spatial_objects``: Xenium transcripts by the pixel they fall in, Visium HD bins shared out by the fraction of the bin each object covers. Each object is owned by one field, so nothing is counted twice across the overlaps. The counts go to ``<object>_expression`` (and for Xenium ``<object>_expression_long``, for Visium HD ``<object>_spot_coverage``) in the fields' ``measurements.db``, keyed by ``prcfo`` like Measure's tables. Infection calls, infected-versus-uninfected tests, the distance trend (to the nearest infected cell, over the uninfected ones), the region summary, the ``.h5ad`` export and an overlay of the field with the most cells go to ``spatial_transcriptomics`` beside the masks.
records.label: spacr.ops_engine.run_spatial_map#1
records.source: Reads the whole Xenium bundle (transcripts at ``spatial_min_qv``) or one Visium HD bin size, puts every point in full-resolution pixels of the slide image (:func:`_st_slide_xy`), then in the frame of each field Spatial Mask Generation wrote (:func:`_st_field_frame`), and counts it into the object of each plane named in ``spatial_objects``: Xenium transcripts by the pixel they fall in, Visium HD bins shared out by the fraction of the bin each object covers. Each object is owned by one field, so nothing is counted twice across the overlaps. The counts go to ``<object>_expression`` (and for Xenium ``<object>_expression_long``, for Visium HD ``<object>_spot_coverage``) in the fields' ``measurements.db``, keyed by ``prcfo`` like Measure's tables. Infection calls, infected-versus-uninfected tests, the distance trend (to the nearest infected cell, over the uninfected ones), the region summary, the ``.h5ad`` export and an overlay of the field with the most cells go to ``spatial_transcriptomics`` beside the masks.
records.translation: Lit l’ensemble du dossier Xenium (transcrits à ``spatial_min_qv``) ou une taille de bin Visium HD, place chaque point en pixels pleine résolution de l’image de la lame (:func:`_st_slide_xy`), puis dans le repère de chaque champ écrit par la Génération de masques spatiale (:func:`_st_field_frame`), et le compte dans l’objet de chaque plan nommé dans ``spatial_objects`` : les transcrits Xenium d’après le pixel où ils tombent, les bins Visium HD répartis selon la fraction du bin que couvre chaque objet. Chaque objet appartient à un seul champ, de sorte que rien n’est compté deux fois dans les chevauchements. Les comptages vont dans ``<object>_expression`` (et, pour Xenium, ``<object>_expression_long``, pour Visium HD, ``<object>_spot_coverage``) dans le ``measurements.db`` des champs, avec la clé ``prcfo`` comme les tables de Measure. Les attributions d’infection, les tests infectées contre non infectées, la tendance en fonction de la distance (à la cellule infectée la plus proche, sur les cellules non infectées), le résumé par région, l’export ``.h5ad`` et une superposition du champ contenant le plus de cellules vont dans ``spatial_transcriptomics`` à côté des masques.

records.context: The slide (or ``spatial_window`` of it) is cut into overlapping windows with :func:`spacr.ops_compose.windows_over`; each window's microscope image fields are read with :func:`_st_read_window`, its nuclei segmented and grown into cells, and the observations sewn and numbered across the seams with :func:`spacr.ops_objects.sew` and :func:`spacr.ops_objects.number`, the OPS window code. Every object is kept from one window that saw all of it, and every window that keeps an object is written as a field: ``stack/<stem>.npy``, ``masks/cell_mask_stack`` and ``masks/nucleus_mask_stack``, and ``merged/<stem>.npy`` (the image data channels, then the cell and nucleus masks) with the image layer-layout file, the layout Mask Generation writes and Measure reads. The fields' places on the slide go to the ``spatial_fields`` table and the objects to ``spatial_objects`` in ``measurements/measurements.db``.
records.label: spacr.ops_engine.run_spatial_masks#1
records.source: The slide (or ``spatial_window`` of it) is cut into overlapping windows with :func:`spacr.ops_compose.windows_over`; each window's tiles are read with :func:`_st_read_window`, its nuclei segmented and grown into cells, and the observations sewn and numbered across the seams with :func:`spacr.ops_objects.sew` and :func:`spacr.ops_objects.number`, the OPS window code. Every object is kept from one window that saw all of it, and every window that keeps an object is written as a field: ``stack/<stem>.npy``, ``masks/cell_mask_stack`` and ``masks/nucleus_mask_stack``, and ``merged/<stem>.npy`` (the channels, then the cell and nucleus masks) with the plane-layout file, the layout Mask Generation writes and Measure reads. The fields' places on the slide go to the ``spatial_fields`` table and the objects to ``spatial_objects`` in ``measurements/measurements.db``.
records.translation: La lame (ou sa ``spatial_window``) est découpée en fenêtres qui se chevauchent avec :func:`spacr.ops_compose.windows_over` ; les tuiles de chaque fenêtre sont lues avec :func:`_st_read_window`, ses noyaux sont segmentés puis étendus en cellules, et les observations sont fusionnées et numérotées à travers les raccords avec :func:`spacr.ops_objects.sew` et :func:`spacr.ops_objects.number`, le code de fenêtres d’OPS. Chaque objet est conservé à partir d’une fenêtre qui l’a vu en entier, et chaque fenêtre qui conserve un objet est écrite comme un champ : ``stack/<stem>.npy``, ``masks/cell_mask_stack`` et ``masks/nucleus_mask_stack``, et ``merged/<stem>.npy`` (les canaux, puis les masques de cellules et de noyaux) avec le fichier de disposition des plans, la structure qu’écrit la Génération de masques et que lit Measure. Les positions des champs sur la lame vont dans la table ``spatial_fields`` et les objets dans ``spatial_objects`` de ``measurements/measurements.db``.

records.context: When ``src`` and ``classes`` are provided the counts are taken from the file listings under ``src/<class>``, avoiding a slow DataLoader iteration on NAS. Hidden files such as the ``.spacr_crop_format.json`` sidecar are not samples and are not counted, the same rule the dataset loader uses.
records.label: spacr.utils.estimate_class_counts#1
records.source: When ``src`` and ``classes`` are provided the counts are taken from the file listings under ``src/<class>``, avoiding a slow DataLoader iteration on NAS. Hidden files such as the ``.spacr_crop_format.json`` sidecar are not samples and are not counted, the same rule the dataset loader uses.
records.translation: Lorsque ``src`` et ``classes`` sont fournis, les comptages sont tirés des listes de fichiers sous ``src/<class>``, ce qui évite une itération lente du DataLoader sur un NAS. Les fichiers cachés, comme le fichier annexe ``.spacr_crop_format.json``, ne sont pas des échantillons et ne sont pas comptés, la même règle que celle du chargeur de jeux de données.
